turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly tests the stated promotion criterion for every tenant class; promotion should wait for these results.
turn_1.expected_observation: Held-out p99 measurements by tenant class will likely show that the customer objective is not yet established and may reveal one or more classes at or above 250 ms despite the improved mean.

turn_2.lesson: The improved aggregate mean masked a severe enterprise-tail regression; promotion fitness must be checked per tenant class using p99, including non-inferiority against the prior policy.
